jobs.title: Field Technician l
jobs.description:
Position Summary

NV5 is a provider of engineering and consulting services to public and private sector clients, delivering solutions through six business verticals: Testing, Inspection & Consulting; Infrastructure; Utility Services; Environmental Health Sciences; Buildings & Program Management; and Geospatial Technology. With offices nationwide and abroad, NV5 helps clients plan, design, build, test, certify, and operate projects that improve the communities where we live and work.

As engineers, architects, construction/program managers, environmental professionals and beyond, we play a significant role in shaping our communities through the services we provide. We are looking for passionate, driven individuals to join our team focused on Delivering Solutions and Improving Lives .

We are seeking a motivated Field Utility Services – Field Technician
to support utility infrastructure documentation and field data collection services using various field data capture tools and related reality capture platforms
. This position is responsible for capturing high-quality geospatial imagery, utility asset data, and field observations to support engineering, construction, utility mapping, and asset management projects.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, comfortable working outdoors, around vehicular traffic, and interested in technology-driven field operations. This is an entry-level to early-career position with opportunities for advancement in engineering, design, surveying, and project management.

Responsibilities

Operate scanning and reality capture equipment to collect utility asset and infrastructure data.
Capture georeferenced imagery and field documentation for utility, telecommunications, transportation, and civil infrastructure projects.
Perform field data collection activities along utility corridors, rights-of-way, roadways, and construction sites.
Verify asset locations and document field conditions using mobile applications and GIS-enabled platforms.
Upload, organize, and maintain project data in accordance with company quality standards.
Assist senior field staff with utility investigations, site assessments, and infrastructure documentation.
Record measurements, field notes, photographs, and observations during project activities.
Support utility mapping and asset inventory projects through accurate data capture and reporting.
Interpreted utility mapping records and as-builts
Perform routine equipment inspections, maintenance, and operational checks.
Adhere to company safety policies, local regulations, and project-specific requirements.
Maintain communication with project managers and field supervisors regarding project progress and field conditions.
Adhere and work around traffic control setup and site safety procedures when required.

Requirements

High school diploma or GED required.
0–2 years of field operations, utility services, construction, surveying, telecommunications, or related experience.
Ability to operate mobile technology, tablets, smartphones, and cloud-based applications.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Excellent organizational and communication skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a field team.
Valid driver's license with acceptable driving record.
Ability to travel to project sites as required.

Preferred Qualifications

Associate degree in Engineering Technology, Geomatics, Construction Management, GIS, or related field preferred.
Experience with utility locating, surveying, or infrastructure documentation.
Familiarity with GPS/GNSS data collection equipment.
Experience working in utility, telecommunications, construction, or engineering environments.
Knowledge of underground utility infrastructure and utility safety practices.

Physical Requirements

Ability to walk long distances across varying terrain.
Ability to work outdoors in varied weather conditions.
Ability to lift and carry equipment up to 50 lbs.
Ability to stand, bend, kneel, and perform field activities for extended periods.
Ability to safely enter active construction and utility work environments.

Work Environment

Primarily field-based position.
Frequent travel to project locations.
Work may occur near roadways, utility infrastructure, and active construction sites.
Occasional overnight travel may be required based on project needs.

The pay range for this California position is $25- $28 per year; however, base pay offered may be higher or lower depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience of the candidate. Full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered. This information is provided per California Senate Bill 1162. Base pay information is based on market location. Applicants should apply via the NV5 careers site.

NV5 offers a competitive compensation and benefits package including medical, dental, life insurance, PTO, 401(k) and professional development/advancement opportunities.

NV5 provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. NV5 complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Benefits

NV5 offers a competitive compensation and benefits package including medical, dental, life insurance, PTO, 401(k) and professional development/advancement opportunities.

Competitive Salary
Medical, dental, and supplemental insurance
Employee Assistance Program
Company paid Life & AD&D
Company paid Disability
401K Plan
Paid Holidays
Paid Time Off

Company Overview

NV5 delivers technology-enabled engineering, consulting, and geospatial solutions that help clients plan, design, and optimize infrastructure, buildings, utilities, and environmental systems. We bring together technical expertise, data, and innovative thinking to create resilient, high-performance assets. As part of TiC Solutions, alongside Acuren, we share a purpose: to shape and strengthen the physical world.

Our work starts with our people. We invest in their growth and never compromise on safety. We work as one team
across disciplines and geographies, bringing diverse perspectives and a shared purpose to complex challenges.

At NV5, we take pride in high-quality work that creates lasting value for our clients. We challenge the status quo, continuously improve, and turn insight into smarter designs, plans, and solutions. Join us to contribute your expertise and collaborate with our teams to help shape the infrastructure and systems the world relies on.

jobs.description:
Job Title:
GIS Specialist

Company:
Celerity

Location:
Remote (work from home eligible) West Coast based with occasional hybrid cadence for meetings and workshops within the San Francisco Bay Area, CA.

Job Type:
Hourly

About Celerity

Celerity is an agile risk optimization company that empowers public utility organizations by converting complex data into clear, actionable intelligence to mitigate risk, optimize assets, and maximize project results. Blending extensive client experience with deep vendor-side acumen, Celerity energy engineers orchestrate precision data analysis, strategic consulting, and project management services to solve complex energy challenges through acute listening, proactive thinking, and relentless grit. Learn more at consultcelerity.com.

Position Overview

The GIS Specialist supports Celerity’s project team by providing geospatial and data management expertise to client projects. This role is responsible for reviewing engineering documents, validating asset data, and using GIS tools to create, analyze, and maintain records and maps. Working closely with engineers and project managers, the GIS Specialist I helps ensure accurate documentation of utility assets, supports quality control processes, and contributes to client deliverables.

Key Responsibilities

Review engineering documents, drawings, and specifications to identify key information for analysis
Verify data on underground and overhead electric system structures, including components, configurations, and supporting documentation of current asset conditions
Perform searches and data validation using client platforms such as GIS, SAP, and document repositories
Conduct GIS functions including creating, modifying, and updating records, maps, and diagrams; querying geodatabases; and extracting data for analysis
Gather and research data from engineering as-built drawings and project documentation
Perform quality control (QC) and review checks for asset inventories, engineering drawings, and related records
Provide mark-ups and redlines on engineering documents in accordance with client and project specifications
Maintain project tracking logs and coordination tools, including status updates, schedules, and challenges
Produce project reports, maps, and updates as needed to support client and internal teams

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Geography, Engineering, or a related discipline; OR a GIS certificate plus relevant experience
At least 1 year of work experience (GIS experience preferred but not required)
Demonstrated skill with Esri ArcGIS (ArcGIS Desktop 10.x/ArcGIS Pro) to develop, edit, and maintain data from engineering as-built drawings
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Access)
Understanding of geographic data types, including land base, imagery, and utility infrastructure
Strong attention to detail and ability to complete complex assignments accurately
Effective verbal and written communication skills; professional demeanor
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team
Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation to travel to client sites
Ability to work extended hours and/or overtime as needed

Physical Requirements

Ability to remain in a stationary position approximately 50% of the time
Ability to operate a computer, scanner, copier, and related office equipment on a regular basis
Must be able to communicate effectively with staff and clients to exchange accurate project information
Ability to move and/or carry boxes up to 40 pounds with or without assistance

The salary range for this position is provided in good faith and is subject to variation based on geographic location, candidate experience, and market conditions. Final compensation will be determined after a comprehensive evaluation of the candidate’s qualifications and alignment with the role.

In accordance with applicable pay transparency laws—including but not limited to those in California, Colorado, New York, Washington, and other jurisdictions—we disclose salary ranges to promote equity and transparency. Where required by law, compensation and benefits information will be included in job postings or made available upon request.

This job description outlines the primary responsibilities and standards of the position but is not exhaustive. Employees may be asked to perform additional duties that are reasonably related to their role and consistent with company policies and applicable labor laws.

jobs.title: Senior Hydrogeologist - Groundwater
jobs.description:
SCS Engineers is looking for a Senior Hydrogeologist
to lead and deliver high‑impact hydrogeology projects across California, Arizona, New Mexico, Nevada, and Utah, with a strong focus on California. In this influential role, you’ll apply your expertise to complex groundwater challenges, guide technical strategy, and shape solutions for landfills and other solid waste management facilities.

You can be based out of any SCS office in the Southwest region
, and we proudly offer hybrid flexibility (3 days/week in office)
to support both collaboration and autonomy.

How You Can Make An Impact

Plan, develop, and execute scientific projects/tasks addressing unique or complex problems or specialty areas. This may involve research of the subject area, definition of scope, selection of investigative approaches, development of novel concepts/solutions, and guiding/reviewing the project/task as it is carried out.
Communicate with clients by email, telephone, and in face-to-face meetings as Project Manager, Client Manager, or Technical Manager or under other Project Manager's direction.
Deliver projects on-time, within scope and within budget.
Write and prepare technical reports. Complete quality control reviews on work products (reports, design plans, calculations, data tables, HASP, etc.).
Delegate portions of project deliverables to junior staff for completion, coordinate and manage field work to be completed by others.
Lead permitting and regulatory agency coordination efforts.
Solicit client feedback, suggest changes for client satisfaction, and anticipate potential issues and develop solutions.
Lead, mentor, delegate to and manage junior staff to grow their knowledge and career path.
Coordinate internal resources and third parties/vendors for executing projects and ensure resource availability and allocation.
Develop relationships with a network of technical experts throughout the company.
Develop proposals by working with clients to understand their goals as well as technical needs and requirements.
Actively attend conferences, present on technical topics, and be involved in professional associations and committees as appropriate.
Have an active role in client prospecting and developing client plans and key opportunity plans.
Review and understand SOPs, standards, and templates and make improvement suggestions; work with junior staff to implement as appropriate.
Help develop new SOP's, standards, and templates.
Participate in strategic and service area annual planning.
Take a lead role in business development for hydrogeologic projects in the Southwest Business Unit.

Qualifications

Bachelor of Science degree in Hydrogeology, Geology, Environmental Chemistry or related science major with hydrogeology coursework required. Masters or PhD is preferred.
Minimum of 15 years of relevant experience required.
Experience with statistical analysis and related groundwater statistical analysis software preferred. Groundwater modeling is a plus.
Experience in landfill and other solid waste management facility projects preferred.
Professional registration (PG, CEG, CHG) preferred.
Valid driver's license with a driving record in good standing required.

USD $100,000.00 - USD $150,000.00 /Yr.

Department Information
Are you interested in making a difference in the lives of fellow Californians while achieving your career goals? Do you set high standards for yourself and enjoy a collaborative and challenging work environment? The mission of the California Department of Social Services is to serve, protect, and support the people of California experiencing need in ways that empower wellbeing and disrupt systemic inequities. The vision of the California Department of Social Services is to provide quality services with a commitment to an inclusive, diverse, and equitable California where all people can thrive.

The Research, Automation, and Data Division’s (RADDs) mission is to improve the way the Department collects, manages, and deploys data to support the efficient, effective, and equitable delivery of government social services. RADD manages major statewide initiatives to streamline and automate eligibility determination and benefit administration for key safety net programs, and leads efforts such as human-centered design, data governance, automation and continuous quality improvement, data visualization and analysis, and research partnerships to improve client outcomes and promote program integrity. Across these efforts, RADD provides coaching to the Department on all aspects of the data lifecycle.

CDSS Guiding Principles

Diversity. Equity. Inclusion. Accessibility. Belonging.
We ensure opportunities for everyone to participate in a meaningful way in fulfilling the mission and vision of CDSS.

Community Engagement
We prioritize the lived experiences of community members as a driving force behind the creation, implementation, desired impact, or change of programs and services.

Empowerment
We engage, operate, and advocate from the understanding that each community and person have desires and capabilities to lead in their own life.

Quality Services
We provide services that align intent and impact by ensuring that they are accessible, community driven, interconnected, and continuously improved.

Data Defined Outcomes
We equitably collect and analyze data, take data-driven action, and measure outcomes relevant to those we serve, ensuring transparency and accountability.

Job Description And Duties
Are you ready to champion data that drives real change for California families? Join the California Department of Social Services (CDSS) as a Research Data Specialist II, where you’ll transform raw data into accurate, timely data products that influence policy decisions, support budget development, and inform how counties deliver critical services. As part of the Research, Automation & Data Division (RADD), and the Research & Data Insights (RDI) Branch, you will contribute to CDSS’s mission of building a sustainable, data-driven culture. You’ll play a pivotal role in producing accurate data required for State and Federal reporting, supporting program partners, and improving outcomes for vulnerable families statewide.

What You’ll Do

Serve as a technical lead for advanced data engineering, data management, and statistical analysis across major social service programs including child welfare, Temporary Aid for Needy Families (TANF), and the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP).
Build and maintain complex reporting pipelines in Snowflake, extracting, validating, and reconciling data from multiple systems to meet detailed State and Federal reporting requirements. Produce compliant, audit-ready reporting files with robust documentation of methodologies and transformations.
Develop original statistical programming and analytical code using SQL (Snowflake), Python, and R. Design reusable datasets, views, and stored procedures; perform sophisticated joins, window functions, and semi-structured data processing. Produce high-quality insights for program oversight, evaluation, and policy development.
Provide technical guidance and mentoring to Research Data Analysts II and Research Data Specialists I, supporting skill development in coding, analytics, and reporting standards. Lead limited-term projects with teams of up to six researchers.

Why Join Us?

Play a key role in building CDSS’s modern, statewide data ecosystem.
Influence high-visibility reporting and analytical work that shapes policy and funding decisions affecting millions.
Collaborate in a mission-driven environment that values innovation, transparency, and human-centered design.
Grow your technical and leadership impact while helping California deliver better services to its most vulnerable populations.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
About UnCruise

At UnCruise Adventures, we work together to provide an enriching adventure experience while inspiring an appreciation of local cultures and the natural world. This means we kayak among icebergs, travel to hidden waterfalls, snorkel with sea lions, dive with manta rays, and share air with whales. Our destinations include Alaska, Hawaiian Islands, Mexico’s Sea of Cortes, Costa Rica, and Galapagos. Every team member plays a role in bringing the adventure to life.

Job Summary

We're looking for a Solutions Engineer who loves diverse technologies to help modernize and support UnCruise's growing IT ecosystem. This is not your typical desk job, you'll go everywhere from a boat bridge to a boardroom.

The first major project for this role is a complete overhaul of our Microsoft 365 environment: rebuilding our SharePoint architecture and file structure, fixing user access and permissions, and putting real governance around how employees and outside guests share documents, while keeping everything properly locked down. From there, this person will be equipped to handle a wide range of ad hoc systems issues and projects across the company, both onboard our vessels and in our office.

Resourcefulness is essential in this role. You should be able to diagnose and resolve problems quickly, and have the patience to communicate with users across a wide range of technical skill levels.

You'll join a growing IT department that's actively expanding its capabilities, with real input into how this role evolves as our needs grow. We look for people who can move fluidly across problems rather than staying narrowly in one lane.   If you are the kind of person who approaches an unfamiliar problem with a plan instead of hesitation, you'll do well here.

This full-time, exempt position reports to the IT Team Lead and is based at our Seattle, WA office at Fishermen's Terminal. Travel to our vessel locations (Alaska, Hawaii, Mexico, Costa Rica, and other destinations) may be required.

Essential Duties – M365 & SharePoint Modernization and Maintenance

•    
 Lead the overhaul of our Microsoft 365 environment, rebuilding SharePoint architecture, file structure, and permissions governance across the organization.
•     Own user access management for SharePoint sites and Teams channels, including how documents are shared securely with employees and outside guests.
•     Administer M365 tenant-level configuration, Entra, Intune, and Defender policy settings.
•     Drive modernization of SharePoint management and own related user training.
•     Build and maintain a lightweight data dictionary or documentation of key metrics/definitions used across dashboards, so reporting stays consistent as ownership changes hands.
•     Create and manage user resource documentation (internal wiki/knowledge base).
•     Upgrade systems with new releases and models; train staff on new technologies.
•     Monitor and maintain network health.

Essential Duties – System Support

•     
Monitor integrations between current CRM systems
•     Develop and manage system improvements through project planning, coordination, training, and promotion of new features.
•     Create new reporting capabilities across multiple databases and respond to ad hoc reporting requests.
•     Promote standardization of business processes across teams and systems to support data integrity.
•     Produce documentation on processes, policies, application configuration, and help materials.
•     Back up and assist with revenue department systems and functions as needed.
•     Partner with Finance, Sales & Marketing, and IT leadership to define what metrics matter and how they should be tracked over time.
•     Assist the VP of Finance and other departments with development of analytic and reporting tools, including dashboards.
•     Leverage Microsoft's Power Platform (PowerApps, Power BI, Dataverse) to automate tasks across teams.

Qualifications

•     
BSc/BA in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
•     Proven experience as a System Administrator, Network Administrator, or similar role.
•     Hands-on M365 administration experience, including Entra ID, Intune, and Microsoft Defender security policies.
•     Experience with SharePoint architecture, governance, and permissions management.
•     Experience managing databases
•     Salesforce Administrator credentials, or strong CRM administration experience.
•     Hands-on experience with integration and automation between systems, using REST APIs, Microsoft's Power Platform, Mulesoft, or similar toolkits.
•     Experience with SQL or similar query-based data manipulation a plus.
•     Knowledge of cloud-based tools and networks, with a preference for Azure and the Office 365 toolkit.
•     Basic understanding of network concepts (VLANs, policy management); experience with SD-WAN or the Unifi ecosystem a plus.
•     Tenacious desire to “Be Better” and never stop learning.
•     Resourcefulness and problem-solving aptitude; comfortable moving at the speed of business.
•     Excellent communication and teaching skills, with patience for users across a wide range of technical skill levels.

Physical Demands / Work Environment

•     
Must be able to work in a standard office environment with sitting, typing, and writing for 8 hours per day.
•     Ability to lift and move electronics and equipment (<30 lbs.), enter crawl spaces on vessels, climb multiple flights of stairs, and work under desks.
•     Occasional work onboard vessels locally or in remote locations, which may require climbing a gangway, or ladder, boarding a skiff and navigating a vessel under construction.
•     Occasional travel to support our vessels.

Work Schedule

This is an exempt position. The work day core hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM; this role may require a flexible schedule with varying hours to include occasional weekends.

Pay and Employee Benefits

•     Base Pay –
$100,000 - $110,000 annually, exempt
•      Cruise Benefit –
Explore the world as our guests do: employees receive one complimentary cruise for two people every year, after each year of employment.
•      Health and Wellness –
Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and flexible spending account options.
•      401k –
Employees are eligible after 6 months of employment with an employer match.
•      Time off –
Enjoy ten company-paid holidays annually. Earn fifteen paid vacation and sick time throughout the year, and qualify for more vacation days as you gain tenure.
•      Give Back to the Community –
Make a difference by volunteering for non-profit and community organizations that you choose using two company-paid volunteer days each year.
•      Eco-Commute –
When you commute to work without the use of a single-occupancy motorized vehicle you will receive a daily stipend. You can carpool, walk, bike, take the bus, or kayak.
•      Free Parking –
Employees park for free at our Seattle office on days they commute by car.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer – Systems Integration (BESS)
jobs.description:
Are you ready to be part of a company that's not just talking about the future, but actively shaping it? Join The AES Corporation, the largest US-based global power company with a team of 8,300 employees across 12 countries.

AES has been ranked #1 by BloombergNEF
in renewable energy sales to corporations in the US and Americas for five consecutive years, providing electricity for millions of people worldwide.

We are proud to foster a strong workplace culture, earning prominent positions in Great Place to Work™ rankings across the markets where we operate. AES was also named one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies for the 13th consecutive year in 2026, highlighting our dedication to integrity, transparency, and responsible business practices.

Our spirit of innovation continues to earn industry recognition. AES is the only seven-time winner of the Edison Electric Institute’s Edison Awards in the twenty-first century, a distinction honoring global leadership in advancing the electric power industry.

If you're ready to be part of a company that's not just adapting to change, but driving it, AES is the place for you. We're not just building a more sustainable future, we're powering it. Apply now and energize your career with a true leader in global energy.

AES is seeking a Solutions Engineer – Systems Integration to contribute to the electrical, controls, and mechanical integration of battery energy storage systems (BESS) for utility-scale renewable energy projects. Working with senior engineers and cross-functional partners, this role supports BESS products from requirements development and qualification through installation, troubleshooting, and operational support.

The engineer helps ensure that BESS subsystems interface correctly and operate safely, reliably, and as intended across project environments. The role applies established engineering methods, develops technical judgment, and takes ownership of defined work packages while escalating complex or high-risk decisions to senior technical leads.

Key Responsibilities

BESS Product Development & Integration

Contribute to systems engineering activities for BESS products from requirements definition through deployment and operation.
Develop and maintain assigned system requirements, interface control documents (ICDs), specifications, compliance matrices, and other integration documentation.
Support integration of energy storage, power conversion systems (PCS), safety systems, controls, communications, and related balance-of-system components.
Review electrical and controls designs, schematics, wiring diagrams, bills of materials (BOMs), and technical submittals; document findings and coordinate resolution with responsible parties.
Apply relevant BESS codes, standards, and project requirements with guidance from senior engineers and subject matter experts.
Support prototype builds, design verification, certification testing, manufacturing transition, and system-level validation activities.
Analyze test and field data, document results, and recommend practical engineering actions within the assigned scope.
Contribute to lessons learned, standards work, RCAs, design tools, and continuous improvement of BESS design and integration practices.
Perform vendor evaluations for BESS BOS component suppliers

Project & Field Support

Provide engineering support for integration of BESS products into utility-scale projects under the direction of a senior technical lead.
Troubleshoot electrical, controls, communications, and system-level issues using structured problem-solving methods.
Participate in root cause analyses, corrective actions, and preventive actions for testing, manufacturing, commissioning, or field issues.
Coordinate with project engineering, commissioning, operations, quality, manufacturing, suppliers, integrators, and other stakeholders to resolve defined technical issues.
Support permitting and local jurisdiction discussions by preparing technical information and responding to assigned questions.
Identify integration risks, maintain action tracking, and communicate technical status, decisions, and open items clearly.
Develop technical guidance, work instructions, presentations, and training materials related to BESS integration, permitting, safety, and emergency response.
Travel to factories, laboratories, and project sites to support inspections, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and technical reviews.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
Approximately 2–4 years of relevant engineering experience in BESS, renewable energy, power systems, controls, product development, systems integration, or complex electromechanical equipment.
Foundational knowledge of electrical systems, controls, communications, power electronics, and system interfaces.
Ability to read and review schematics, wiring diagrams, specifications, technical drawings, and bills of materials.
Experience supporting engineering analysis, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, or technical documentation.
Working knowledge of structured problem solving, requirements management, verification, and configuration control.
Ability to organize technical work, manage assigned deliverables, and communicate effectively with internal teams, suppliers, and contractors.
Willingness to travel to factories and project sites, approximately 25%.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with utility-scale battery energy storage, solar, or other renewable energy projects.
Familiarity with BESS and electrical safety standards, including UL 9540, UL 9540A, NFPA 855, NFPA 72, NFPA 68, NFPA 69, NFPA 110, NFPA 111, IFC, IEC standards, and applicable electrical codes.
Hands-on experience with battery, electrical, controls, networking, or data-acquisition test equipment.
Experience working with equipment manufacturers, system integrators, engineering firms, laboratories, construction teams, or operations personnel.
Experience using engineering requirements, issue-tracking, document-control, or configuration-management tools.
2D / 3D CAD program experience

P2 Scope & Expected Contribution

Independently completes well-defined engineering assignments and owns assigned deliverables from planning through closure.
Applies established engineering principles and standards, seeking guidance for novel, ambiguous, or high-consequence decisions.
Builds technical depth in BESS systems integration and develops broader understanding of product and project interfaces.
Communicates risks and recommendations with supporting evidence and follows through on actions across functional boundaries.
Shares knowledge with peers and contributes to team procedures, templates, and continuous improvement.

GIS Analyst – ArcGIS, SQL & GIS Application Development

Position Overview

Support highly complex GIS applications while working across spatial data, GIS application development, database technologies, testing, and web/mobile applications. This role provides opportunities to work closely with development teams and Project Managers to improve GIS solutions, streamline spatial data needs, and support application quality, milestones, and deadlines.

The role will primarily support applications associated with environmental and natural-resource functions, with additional application development support assigned as needed.

What You'll Do / Key Responsibilities

Support multiple highly complex GIS applications.
Collaborate with development staff by providing advice and guidance as needed.
Work closely with Project Managers to ensure project quality, milestones, and deadlines are met.
Develop solutions and streamline spatial data needs through the maintenance and modification of existing web, client/server, or mobile applications.
Support additional application development needs as assigned.
Adhere to applicable technology and client standards.
Develop or approve plans for testing and implementation of web-based, client/server, mobile, or data system applications.
Evaluate the impact of new technology and recommend solutions to persistent problems.
Serve as a customer service liaison to the client and external consultants.
Maintain current knowledge of changing IT technologies through continuous learning.
Support applications across PC-based, web-based, and mobile platforms.
Support legacy application development and maintenance where applicable.

Required Qualifications

4 years of experience in GIS, cartography, CADD, or a related field.
4 years of experience developing user interfaces, menus, and macro-level commands, performing complex spatial analyses, and producing reports according to customer specifications.
Experience with ArcGIS Online (AGOL) and Portal.
Builder skills.
Dashboard skills.
4 years of experience assisting in the development of GIS that create, maintain, or leverage geospatial basemap information.
Experience creating basemaps and tile caches.
Experience with imagery analysis.
4 years of advanced SQL skills, including writing database scripts, stored procedures, functions, triggers, and SSIS packages.
Experience maintaining spatial databases, documenting procedures, validating data, and updating and maintaining metadata for new and existing items.
4 years of advanced skills in unit testing, system testing, regression testing, and automated testing to ensure product quality meets client expectations.
2 years of experience with C#.NET, VB.NET, ASP.NET, XML, AJAX, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Transact SQL (T-SQL), TypeScript, and Power Apps.
Knowledge of ADA Compliance with 1+ years of experience.
Bachelor's degree required. Foreign degrees will be accepted if evaluated as equivalent to a U.S. bachelor's degree.

1+ years of experience with MS ADO, GIT, MS Office, and Helix.
1+ years of experience with Angular.

jobs.title: Groundwater Modeler / Hydrogeologist
jobs.description:
Matrix New World Engineering, a part of True Environmental and its partner firms, have united their strengths to establish the nation's premier environmental and engineering services consulting firm. This powerhouse organization offers an extensive range of services aimed at revolutionizing the built environment and preserving the natural one. Its diverse expertise encompasses environmental remediation, urban planning, engineering iconic coastal and marine structures, developing sustainable energy sources, and pioneering resource extraction methods. Explore further at www.MWNE.com and True-Environmental.com to discover the full scope of our capabilities.

Matrix New World Engineering, a part of True Environmental, is seeking a Groundwater Modeler /
Hydrogeologist
to join our team in Phoenix, AZ
. The position will be a full-time position, with flexibility to work in our Phoenix office or remotely and will provide full company benefits that will be provided during interviews. Matrix is an equal opportunity employer.

Our Arizona Water Services group focuses on hydrogeological and environmental consulting with offices in Phoenix and Prescott, and remote staff located in North and South America. The ideal candidate will participate in groundwater flow and contaminant transport modeling and support hydrogeologic investigations for water resources and environmental consulting projects.

What You'll Do

Build, calibrate, and apply numerical groundwater flow and solute transport models under the direction of senior technical staff
Perform sensitivity, uncertainty, and predictive analyses for water resource and remediation modeling projects
Compile, evaluate, and manage spatial and subsurface datasets (including geologic, hydrogeologic, and water quality data) to support Conceptual Site Model (CSM) development
Assist with technical aspects of projects supporting regulatory frameworks, such as the Arizona Department of Environmental Quality (ADEQ) permitting programs such as Aquifer Protection Permit (APP) and Arizona Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (AZPDES) permit applications
Assist with ADWR Assured and Adequate Water Supply (AWS) applications including aquifer impact analysis
Assist with Hydrogeologic characterization in support of developing managed aquifer recharge (MAR) sites and aquifer storage and recovery (ASR) wells, including projected groundwater mounding
Assist with data collection, aquifer testing analysis, and data interpretation
Draft technical reports, memos, figures, and technical appendices for project deliverables
Support Project Managers with cost estimation, proposal preparation, and task management

Minimum Requirements

Education: Bachelor's degree in Geology, Hydrology, Environmental Science, or related field; Master’s degree preferred
Professional Experience: 3 years of experience with a Master’s degree or 6 years of experience with a Bachelor’s degree in groundwater modeling, hydrogeology, water resources, or environmental consulting
Modeling Software: Hands-on proficiency with numerical groundwater flow and transport modeling software, including MODFLOW, MODPATH, and MT3D. Familiarity with pre-processing applications such as Groundwater Vistas

Lead complex environmental investigations, remediation programs, emergency response activities, and related field and office assignments from planning through completion.

U.S. Army Environmental Science / Engineering Officers diligently work to safeguard our nation’s heroes and their families from health hazards.

As a professional in the environmental science or environmental engineer field, a career as an Army Environmental Science / Engineering Officer might be one for you.

Outstanding Benefits and Opportunities

As an Environmental Science / Engineering Officer for the U.S. Army, you will identify and evaluate potential health risks and develop a course of action to control or prevent disease, illness, and injury. You may supervise the scientific research for environmental health and industrial hygiene, assess weapons, equipment, clothing, and material systems, and develop policies, programs, and operations to ensure the health and safety of Soldiers and staff. You will attend trainings, continued education programs, seminars, and conferences to broaden your knowledge base, collaborate with other top professionals and interact with the newest technologies in the field.

If you choose to join the Army Reserve, you will be able to serve your country as needed while still supporting your community.

Regardless of how you choose to serve, a career as an Army Environmental Science / Engineering Officer allows you to be all you can be.

Outstanding Benefits and Opportunities

When you join the Army Medical Service Corps, you’ll be making a difference in the lives of our Soldiers and the country at large while gaining access to invaluable opportunities, like supporting humanitarian missions, being part of a dedicated healthcare team, and leadership training, all while earning a competitive benefits package.

Benefits may include:
★ Repayment of qualified education loans to lending institution, paid annually over a maximum of 3 years while serving
★ Based on your field of concentration, you may be eligible for an accession bonus
★ Travel opportunities within the United States and abroad
★ Up to 30 days of paid vacation earned annually
★ Enrollment into the Uniformed Services Blended Retirement System
★ No- to low-cost medical and dental care for you and your family
★ Commissary and post exchange shopping privileges
★ Specialized training to become a leader in medicine

Eligibility Requirements

★ Must have a bachelor’s degree from an educational program accredited by the Council on Education for Public Health with a major in a public-health-relevant field or a bachelor’s degree from a program accredited by the Accreditation Board for Engineering and Technology with a major in an environmental engineering-relevant field
★ Must be a U.S. citizen to serve Active Duty
★ Must have a permanent U.S. residency for Army Reserve

To find out more information about becoming an Environmental Science / Engineering Officer in the U.S. Army, visit www.goarmy.com/medicine. Job Description

We're looking for a Field Technician with hands-on construction materials testing experience who is ready to hit the ground running. This is an active, field-based role where you'll spend your days on construction sites, road projects, and in testing facilities helping ensure the quality and integrity of critical infrastructure projects.

One day you may be testing fresh concrete at a high-rise development. Comfortable working outdoors in varying weather conditions and on active construction sites.
Ability to travel between multiple job sites throughout the day as project demands require.
Strong mathematical aptitude and attention to detail.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work independently while maintaining a high level of accuracy and professionalism.

Experience performing ASTM field testing procedures.

Exposure to large-scale commercial and infrastructure construction projects.
Opportunity to build specialized technical expertise in construction materials testing.
Combination of fieldwork, laboratory support, and project collaboration.

Your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Description
Summary:

The Solutions Engineer will serve as the technical lead for Globalgig customers from the first design conversation through renewal. The role combines Presales Engineering with Customer Success Engineering: the Solutions Engineer owns single-domain opportunities across SD-WAN, SASE, network security, connectivity, and wireless from discovery to signature, works alongside Field CTOs to close complex, multi-domain deals, and then stays with each customer through delivery, onboarding, Day 2 operations, adoption, optimization, renewal, and expansion.

Reporting to the VP of Solutions Engineering, this position will ensure that what Globalgig sells can be built, is delivered as designed, and continues to deliver value for the life of the contract.

Essential Job Duties:

▪       Own technical discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, and high-level architecture for single-domain opportunities, including the accuracy of the bill of materials (BOM) and statement of work (SOW).
▪       Partner with Field CTOs to close complex, multi-domain deals by delivering demonstrations, proof of value, and proof-of-concept work, then take ownership of the design at signature, validating configuration, licensing, serviceability, and deliverability before the deal closes.
▪       Own customer-facing technical documentation for the life of the contract, including architecture diagrams, policy maps, integration flows, and technical write-ups.
▪       Lead the technical handoff from Sales to Delivery, Project Management, and Engineering, and stay engaged through deployment to keep detailed designs aligned with the solution that was sold.
▪       Guide customers through onboarding and implementation, including access to portals and tools, runbooks, network diagrams, and training on management consoles.
▪       Transition customers into Day 2 operations, partner with the NOC on incidents and escalations, run regular optimization check-ins, and serve as the customer’s primary technical point of continuity after deployment.
▪       Build adoption plans for each customer’s management and monitoring platforms across Cisco, Palo Alto Networks, and Fortinet, and measure adoption against KPIs agreed with the customer.
▪       Lead the technical portion of quarterly business reviews, covering performance and SLA adherence, capacity, incidents and risk, adoption, and recommended upgrades or architecture improvements.
▪       Keep customers informed on new features, software releases, security vulnerabilities, and end-of-life and end-of-support timelines, and turn lifecycle events into refresh opportunities.
▪       Drive renewals and expansion with Sales and Channel teams by starting renewal conversations well ahead of contract end, surfacing out-of-scope requests as new opportunities, and building pipeline across the installed base.
▪       Share structured field feedback with Product Operations on platform gaps and customer needs, and contribute to reference architectures, templates, and playbooks.
▪       Support the VP of Solutions Engineering with additional tasks as needed.
Reporting Relationships:

▪       Direct supervision given from VP of Solutions Engineering
▪       Key Working Relationships: Sales and Channel teams, Field CTOs, Delivery, Project Management, NOC, Engineering, Marketing, and Product Operations
Requirements:

▪       Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience
▪       Deep, hands-on knowledge of enterprise networking and security, including SD-WAN, SASE and SSE, Zero Trust, cloud networking, and endpoint detection and response (EDR/XDR)
▪       Working depth in Cisco, Palo Alto Networks, and Fortinet solutions, and wireless solutions
▪       Ability to run discovery, design, and BOM/SOW development independently, and to quickly absorb, challenge, and validate an architecture designed by others
▪       Ability to interpret performance trends and telemetry and turn them into clear customer recommendations
▪       Understanding of service delivery models, provisioning workflows, and operational constraints
▪       Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technology in business terms to both engineers and CIO/CISO-level audiences
▪       Strong documentation skills, including architecture diagrams, technical write-ups, and business review materials
▪       Ability to manage multiple customer accounts at once and balance presales and post-sale priorities
▪       Self-motivated with the ability to prioritize, execute, and handle escalations while maintaining customer trust
Preferred:

▪       Industry certifications such as PCNSE, CCNP, Fortinet NSE/FCP, or CISSP (Globalgig supports ongoing certification)
▪       Experience in a post-sale role such as customer success engineering, technical account management, or professional services
▪       Experience with managed service providers or indirect channel sales organizations
▪       Ability to work within a cooperative team environment, as well as perform assignments autonomously
Physical Requirements:

▪       Ability to sit or stand at a computer terminal for long periods of time.
▪       Ability to work remotely, with in-person customer meetings and events as needed
▪       Ability to travel approximately 25% of the time

Globalgig is a managed security and network services provider that helps enterprises connect, secure, and manage distributed environments across sites, users, the cloud, and IoT. Its portfolio spans SD-WAN and SASE, network security, wireless, and managed network services, delivered through the Orchestra platform in more than 195 countries and territories. Headquartered in San Antonio, Texas, Globalgig is ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certified and has been named to the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing private companies seven consecutive times.

jobs.title: Data Analyst-OPT (Personnel Data)
jobs.description:
POSITION TITLE (Oracle title)

DATA ANALYST

WORKING TITLE

Data Analyst-OPT (Personnel Data)

SCHOOL/DEPARTMENT

Human Resources-Salary and Information Systems

LOCATION

Crossroads III, Cary, NC

PAY GRADE

Noncertified Grade 26

FLSA STATUS

Nonexempt

ELIGIBILITY FOR EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT

No

WORK WEEK SCHEDULE

Monday-Friday (occasional evenings and weekends) Position is available for a Hybrid Telework workweek

Position Purpose

As a member of the Oracle Processing Team (OPT), this position manages and analyzes data related to any employment status changes in the Wake County Public School System’s (WCPSS) Oracle database and assists in responding to questions received in Human Resources, as needed.

Minimum Qualifications

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES (KSAs)

Considerable knowledge of Microsoft Office, specifically Microsoft Word, Excel (analyzing data and performing calculations using databases and spreadsheets), Power Point; Google Apps;
Considerable knowledge of interrelated functions between human resources, payroll, and benefit processes;
Excellent customer service and organizational skills;
Ability to communicate clearly and concisely both in oral and written form using a variety of communication techniques and tools to ensure the appropriate flow of information, collaborative efforts, and feedback;
Ability to gather and analyze pertinent facts, arrive at conclusions or recommendations, and present information in an easily understood and reportable format;
Ability to complete complex tasks and minimize errors with attention to detail;
Ability to work in a team environment;
Ability to work independently and complete tasks in the absence of clear direction;
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with school system staff, staff members of external funding agencies, and the community.

Education, Training, And Experience

Associates degree from a regionally accredited college or university;
Two years of experience in Business, Human Resources, or a related field;
Experience in analyzing and researching data based on policies and procedures.

An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential duties of the job may be considered.

Certification And License Requirements

None

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Oracle (in reference to Human Resource functions);
Experience in a public school setting working in a Human Resources or Payroll department;
Experience using the online state Licensure and Salary System, North Carolina Identity Management (NCID) System, and the NC Retirement System (ORBIT).

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Analyzes and researches Oracle position data and recommendations for employment (e.g., split positions, end dating positions, researching position history to ensure accuracy, etc.) and evaluates results in order to provide solutions and/or recommendations based on research.
Enters personnel information, from multiple sources, into the Oracle database application relating to new hires, rehires, status changes, transfers, resignations, salary, licensure, contract information, longevity, and other relevant employment data.
Prepares appropriate information to be included in Board of Education reports as it relates to the new hire and rehire status.
Collaborates with other Central Services departments (e.g., Budget, Compensation Services, etc.) to ensure employees are set up and compensated accurately.
Maintains workflow records of Oracle data and processing.
Develops a thorough knowledge of salary schedules, pay cycles, and employee calendars to ensure accurate and timely entry of time sensitive personnel data.
Develops a solid understanding of WCPSS employee benefits and eligibility as it pertains to employment contracts.
Maintains effective working relationships with Human Resources Administrators and Specialists to transition applicants to employee status in Oracle.
Communicates employment status and assignment changes with WCPSS’ Compensation Services (Payroll) to facilitate accurate processing.
Processes employment verification, state service years of service, and the transfer of leave balances.
Responsible for ensuring that monthly payroll cycle deadlines are met.
Performs other related duties, as assigned.

Work Environment/Physical Requirements

This job operates in a professional office environment and has a noise level of mostly low to moderate. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, scanners, and copiers. The position, at times, must be able to come into direct contact with school system staff, staff members of external funding agencies, and the community. Work is considered light physical work, requiring the exertion of up to ten pounds of force.

EFFECTIVE DATE:
10/2025

They are not intended to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required by the employees assigned to this position. This description may be revised by HR and approved at any time.

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

The Water Business Line is actively seeking a highly motivated full-time Construction Project Coordinator for immediate employment in the Pittsburgh office. The appropriately qualified applicant shall demonstrate initiative and willingness to learn on the job. The applicant shall assist with delivery of our existing and future projects with municipal clients including PWSA and Alcosan.

Duties will include project document management of meeting minutes, payment applications, daily reports, materials ticket books, material testing, certified payrolls, deliverables, and performing additional project administrative procedural requirements to include supporting quality control evaluations of inspector submissions and contractor work.

Familiarity with construction field practices.
Comfortable visiting project sites to discuss quality control and quality assurance issues with inspectors and contractors.

Monitor’s contractor personnel to ensure adherence with project plans and promotes quality control of all installations
Enforces policies, procedures and related work rules as established by Field Management.

advances student belonging and holistic success by coordinating programs, services, and engagement opportunities that support students at the University of Nebraska–Lincoln.

Develop, coordinate, initiate campus partnerships, and implement student programmatic initiatives focused on creating a campus climate of cultural excellence and belonging with a goal of increasing student success, recruitment, and retention.

We advance student success by connecting individuals to resources that address basic needs, support academic and personal development, and build leadership capacity. We empower students not only to navigate campus life but also to shape it.

At the University of Nebraska–Lincoln, we’re proud to be consistently recognized by Forbes as a top employer and recently earned the Lincoln Family Friendly Workplace
certification. We are known for our welcoming, supportive environment, commitment to professional growth, and outstanding benefits. UNL isn’t just a workplace; it’s a place to build your career and make a meaningful impact in Nebraska.

Generous paid time off, including vacation, sick leave, parental leave, and holidays

We equitably collect and analyze data, take data-driven action, and measure outcomes relevant to those we serve, ensuring transparency and accountability.

Job Description And Duties
Are you ready to champion data that drives real change for California families? Join the California Department of Social Services (CDSS) as a Research Data Specialist II, where you’ll transform raw data into accurate, timely data products that influence policy decisions, support budget development, and inform how counties deliver critical services. As part of the Research, Automation & Data Division (RADD), and the Research & Data Insights (RDI) Branch, you will contribute to CDSS’s mission of building a sustainable, data-driven culture. You’ll play a pivotal role in producing accurate data required for State and Federal reporting, supporting program partners, and improving outcomes for vulnerable families statewide.

What You’ll Do

Serve as a technical lead for advanced data engineering, data management, and statistical analysis across major social service programs including child welfare, Temporary Aid for Needy Families (TANF), and the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP).
Build and maintain complex reporting pipelines in Snowflake, extracting, validating, and reconciling data from multiple systems to meet detailed State and Federal reporting requirements. Produce compliant, audit-ready reporting files with robust documentation of methodologies and transformations.
Develop original statistical programming and analytical code using SQL (Snowflake), Python, and R. Design reusable datasets, views, and stored procedures; perform sophisticated joins, window functions, and semi-structured data processing. Produce high-quality insights for program oversight, evaluation, and policy development.
Provide technical guidance and mentoring to Research Data Analysts II and Research Data Specialists I, supporting skill development in coding, analytics, and reporting standards. Lead limited-term projects with teams of up to six researchers.

Why Join Us?

Play a key role in building CDSS’s modern, statewide data ecosystem.
Influence high-visibility reporting and analytical work that shapes policy and funding decisions affecting millions.
Collaborate in a mission-driven environment that values innovation, transparency, and human-centered design.
Grow your technical and leadership impact while helping California deliver better services to its most vulnerable populations.

new_jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
new_jobs.description:
About UnCruise

At UnCruise Adventures, we work together to provide an enriching adventure experience while inspiring an appreciation of local cultures and the natural world. This means we kayak among icebergs, travel to hidden waterfalls, snorkel with sea lions, dive with manta rays, and share air with whales. Our destinations include Alaska, Hawaiian Islands, Mexico’s Sea of Cortes, Costa Rica, and Galapagos. Every team member plays a role in bringing the adventure to life.

Job Summary

We're looking for a Solutions Engineer who loves diverse technologies to help modernize and support UnCruise's growing IT ecosystem. This is not your typical desk job, you'll go everywhere from a boat bridge to a boardroom.

The first major project for this role is a complete overhaul of our Microsoft 365 environment: rebuilding our SharePoint architecture and file structure, fixing user access and permissions, and putting real governance around how employees and outside guests share documents, while keeping everything properly locked down. From there, this person will be equipped to handle a wide range of ad hoc systems issues and projects across the company, both onboard our vessels and in our office.

Resourcefulness is essential in this role. You should be able to diagnose and resolve problems quickly, and have the patience to communicate with users across a wide range of technical skill levels.

You'll join a growing IT department that's actively expanding its capabilities, with real input into how this role evolves as our needs grow. We look for people who can move fluidly across problems rather than staying narrowly in one lane.   If you are the kind of person who approaches an unfamiliar problem with a plan instead of hesitation, you'll do well here.

This full-time, exempt position reports to the IT Team Lead and is based at our Seattle, WA office at Fishermen's Terminal. Travel to our vessel locations (Alaska, Hawaii, Mexico, Costa Rica, and other destinations) may be required.

Essential Duties – M365 & SharePoint Modernization and Maintenance

•    
 Lead the overhaul of our Microsoft 365 environment, rebuilding SharePoint architecture, file structure, and permissions governance across the organization.
•     Own user access management for SharePoint sites and Teams channels, including how documents are shared securely with employees and outside guests.
•     Administer M365 tenant-level configuration, Entra, Intune, and Defender policy settings.
•     Drive modernization of SharePoint management and own related user training.
•     Build and maintain a lightweight data dictionary or documentation of key metrics/definitions used across dashboards, so reporting stays consistent as ownership changes hands.
•     Create and manage user resource documentation (internal wiki/knowledge base).
•     Upgrade systems with new releases and models; train staff on new technologies.
•     Monitor and maintain network health.

Essential Duties – System Support

•     
Monitor integrations between current CRM systems
•     Develop and manage system improvements through project planning, coordination, training, and promotion of new features.
•     Create new reporting capabilities across multiple databases and respond to ad hoc reporting requests.
•     Promote standardization of business processes across teams and systems to support data integrity.
•     Produce documentation on processes, policies, application configuration, and help materials.
•     Back up and assist with revenue department systems and functions as needed.
•     Partner with Finance, Sales & Marketing, and IT leadership to define what metrics matter and how they should be tracked over time.
•     Assist the VP of Finance and other departments with development of analytic and reporting tools, including dashboards.
•     Leverage Microsoft's Power Platform (PowerApps, Power BI, Dataverse) to automate tasks across teams.

Qualifications

•     
BSc/BA in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
•     Proven experience as a System Administrator, Network Administrator, or similar role.
•     Hands-on M365 administration experience, including Entra ID, Intune, and Microsoft Defender security policies.
•     Experience with SharePoint architecture, governance, and permissions management.
•     Experience managing databases
•     Salesforce Administrator credentials, or strong CRM administration experience.
•     Hands-on experience with integration and automation between systems, using REST APIs, Microsoft's Power Platform, Mulesoft, or similar toolkits.
•     Experience with SQL or similar query-based data manipulation a plus.
•     Knowledge of cloud-based tools and networks, with a preference for Azure and the Office 365 toolkit.
•     Basic understanding of network concepts (VLANs, policy management); experience with SD-WAN or the Unifi ecosystem a plus.
•     Tenacious desire to “Be Better” and never stop learning.
•     Resourcefulness and problem-solving aptitude; comfortable moving at the speed of business.
•     Excellent communication and teaching skills, with patience for users across a wide range of technical skill levels.

Physical Demands / Work Environment

•     
Must be able to work in a standard office environment with sitting, typing, and writing for 8 hours per day.
•     Ability to lift and move electronics and equipment (<30 lbs.), enter crawl spaces on vessels, climb multiple flights of stairs, and work under desks.
•     Occasional work onboard vessels locally or in remote locations, which may require climbing a gangway, or ladder, boarding a skiff and navigating a vessel under construction.
•     Occasional travel to support our vessels.

Work Schedule

This is an exempt position. The work day core hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM; this role may require a flexible schedule with varying hours to include occasional weekends.

Pay and Employee Benefits

•     Base Pay –
$100,000 - $110,000 annually, exempt
•      Cruise Benefit –
Explore the world as our guests do: employees receive one complimentary cruise for two people every year, after each year of employment.
•      Health and Wellness –
Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and flexible spending account options.
•      401k –
Employees are eligible after 6 months of employment with an employer match.
•      Time off –
Enjoy ten company-paid holidays annually. Earn fifteen paid vacation and sick time throughout the year, and qualify for more vacation days as you gain tenure.
•      Give Back to the Community –
Make a difference by volunteering for non-profit and community organizations that you choose using two company-paid volunteer days each year.
•      Eco-Commute –
When you commute to work without the use of a single-occupancy motorized vehicle you will receive a daily stipend. You can carpool, walk, bike, take the bus, or kayak.
•      Free Parking –
Employees park for free at our Seattle office on days they commute by car.

Disclaimer Statement

This job description is intended only to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by an employee in this position. It is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills or abilities required or persons so classified or assigned. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
It is the policy of UnCruise Adventures not to discriminate on the basis of race, color, sex, creed, religion, marital status, citizenship, the presence of any sensory, mental, or physical disability, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, ancestry, national origin, or veteran status in its educational programs, activities, or employment as required by law.

new_jobs.description:
Are you ready to be part of a company that's not just talking about the future, but actively shaping it? Join The AES Corporation, the largest US-based global power company with a team of 8,300 employees across 12 countries.

AES has been ranked #1 by BloombergNEF
in renewable energy sales to corporations in the US and Americas for five consecutive years, providing electricity for millions of people worldwide.

We are proud to foster a strong workplace culture, earning prominent positions in Great Place to Work™ rankings across the markets where we operate. AES was also named one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies for the 13th consecutive year in 2026, highlighting our dedication to integrity, transparency, and responsible business practices.

Our spirit of innovation continues to earn industry recognition. AES is the only seven-time winner of the Edison Electric Institute’s Edison Awards in the twenty-first century, a distinction honoring global leadership in advancing the electric power industry.

If you're ready to be part of a company that's not just adapting to change, but driving it, AES is the place for you. We're not just building a more sustainable future, we're powering it. Apply now and energize your career with a true leader in global energy.

AES is seeking a Solutions Engineer – Systems Integration to contribute to the electrical, controls, and mechanical integration of battery energy storage systems (BESS) for utility-scale renewable energy projects. Working with senior engineers and cross-functional partners, this role supports BESS products from requirements development and qualification through installation, troubleshooting, and operational support.

The engineer helps ensure that BESS subsystems interface correctly and operate safely, reliably, and as intended across project environments. The role applies established engineering methods, develops technical judgment, and takes ownership of defined work packages while escalating complex or high-risk decisions to senior technical leads.

Key Responsibilities

BESS Product Development & Integration

Contribute to systems engineering activities for BESS products from requirements definition through deployment and operation.
Develop and maintain assigned system requirements, interface control documents (ICDs), specifications, compliance matrices, and other integration documentation.
Support integration of energy storage, power conversion systems (PCS), safety systems, controls, communications, and related balance-of-system components.
Review electrical and controls designs, schematics, wiring diagrams, bills of materials (BOMs), and technical submittals; document findings and coordinate resolution with responsible parties.
Apply relevant BESS codes, standards, and project requirements with guidance from senior engineers and subject matter experts.
Support prototype builds, design verification, certification testing, manufacturing transition, and system-level validation activities.
Analyze test and field data, document results, and recommend practical engineering actions within the assigned scope.
Contribute to lessons learned, standards work, RCAs, design tools, and continuous improvement of BESS design and integration practices.
Perform vendor evaluations for BESS BOS component suppliers

Project & Field Support

Provide engineering support for integration of BESS products into utility-scale projects under the direction of a senior technical lead.
Troubleshoot electrical, controls, communications, and system-level issues using structured problem-solving methods.
Participate in root cause analyses, corrective actions, and preventive actions for testing, manufacturing, commissioning, or field issues.
Coordinate with project engineering, commissioning, operations, quality, manufacturing, suppliers, integrators, and other stakeholders to resolve defined technical issues.
Support permitting and local jurisdiction discussions by preparing technical information and responding to assigned questions.
Identify integration risks, maintain action tracking, and communicate technical status, decisions, and open items clearly.
Develop technical guidance, work instructions, presentations, and training materials related to BESS integration, permitting, safety, and emergency response.
Travel to factories, laboratories, and project sites to support inspections, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and technical reviews.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
Approximately 2–4 years of relevant engineering experience in BESS, renewable energy, power systems, controls, product development, systems integration, or complex electromechanical equipment.
Foundational knowledge of electrical systems, controls, communications, power electronics, and system interfaces.
Ability to read and review schematics, wiring diagrams, specifications, technical drawings, and bills of materials.
Experience supporting engineering analysis, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, or technical documentation.
Working knowledge of structured problem solving, requirements management, verification, and configuration control.
Ability to organize technical work, manage assigned deliverables, and communicate effectively with internal teams, suppliers, and contractors.
Willingness to travel to factories and project sites, approximately 25%.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with utility-scale battery energy storage, solar, or other renewable energy projects.
Familiarity with BESS and electrical safety standards, including UL 9540, UL 9540A, NFPA 855, NFPA 72, NFPA 68, NFPA 69, NFPA 110, NFPA 111, IFC, IEC standards, and applicable electrical codes.
Hands-on experience with battery, electrical, controls, networking, or data-acquisition test equipment.
Experience working with equipment manufacturers, system integrators, engineering firms, laboratories, construction teams, or operations personnel.
Experience using engineering requirements, issue-tracking, document-control, or configuration-management tools.
2D / 3D CAD program experience

P2 Scope & Expected Contribution

Independently completes well-defined engineering assignments and owns assigned deliverables from planning through closure.
Applies established engineering principles and standards, seeking guidance for novel, ambiguous, or high-consequence decisions.
Builds technical depth in BESS systems integration and develops broader understanding of product and project interfaces.
Communicates risks and recommendations with supporting evidence and follows through on actions across functional boundaries.
Shares knowledge with peers and contributes to team procedures, templates, and continuous improvement.

Job Description

GIS Analyst – ArcGIS, SQL & GIS Application Development

Position Overview

Support highly complex GIS applications while working across spatial data, GIS application development, database technologies, testing, and web/mobile applications. This role provides opportunities to work closely with development teams and Project Managers to improve GIS solutions, streamline spatial data needs, and support application quality, milestones, and deadlines.

The role will primarily support applications associated with environmental and natural-resource functions, with additional application development support assigned as needed.

What You'll Do / Key Responsibilities

Support multiple highly complex GIS applications.
Collaborate with development staff by providing advice and guidance as needed.
Work closely with Project Managers to ensure project quality, milestones, and deadlines are met.
Develop solutions and streamline spatial data needs through the maintenance and modification of existing web, client/server, or mobile applications.
Support additional application development needs as assigned.
Adhere to applicable technology and client standards.
Develop or approve plans for testing and implementation of web-based, client/server, mobile, or data system applications.
Evaluate the impact of new technology and recommend solutions to persistent problems.
Serve as a customer service liaison to the client and external consultants.
Maintain current knowledge of changing IT technologies through continuous learning.
Support applications across PC-based, web-based, and mobile platforms.
Support legacy application development and maintenance where applicable.

Required Qualifications

4 years of experience in GIS, cartography, CADD, or a related field.
4 years of experience developing user interfaces, menus, and macro-level commands, performing complex spatial analyses, and producing reports according to customer specifications.
Experience with ArcGIS Online (AGOL) and Portal.
Builder skills.
Dashboard skills.
4 years of experience assisting in the development of GIS that create, maintain, or leverage geospatial basemap information.
Experience creating basemaps and tile caches.
Experience with imagery analysis.
4 years of advanced SQL skills, including writing database scripts, stored procedures, functions, triggers, and SSIS packages.
Experience maintaining spatial databases, documenting procedures, validating data, and updating and maintaining metadata for new and existing items.

At Weston Solutions, Inc. you will do meaningful work and make valuable contributions. Employee ownership at Weston is a path to professional growth and access to diverse opportunities in a highly connected community that works together across key service areas to make a difference in the environment. Weston is hiring a Senior Project Scientist to support environmental investigation, remediation, and emergency response projects that protect public health and the environment. This role is ideal for an experienced technical leader who can manage complex field efforts, guide technical decisions, and deliver high-quality client outcomes.

This position supports a critical project with work expected to begin soon. Weston is proactively interviewing to prepare for onboarding as project activities ramp up. Start timing will align with project kickoff and mobilization schedules.

Location: Pittsburgh, PA

Key Responsibilities

Lead complex environmental investigations, remediation programs, emergency response activities, and related field and office assignments from planning through completion.
Manage project execution in accordance with scope, budget, schedule, technical requirements, regulatory standards, Weston procedures, and client expectations.
Plan and oversee field investigations and sampling programs at active construction, remediation, and potentially hazardous sites.
Direct field staff, subcontractors, and multidisciplinary teams while coordinating resources and reinforcing safe, efficient work practices.
Analyze field observations, analytical data, and monitoring results to develop defensible conclusions, recommendations, and project strategies.
Prepare and review scientific reports, investigation summaries, removal action documentation, technical memoranda, work plans, sampling plans, health and safety plans, quality assurance documents, schedules, budgets, and other deliverables.
